title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Valencia grid point, race Sundays 2015-2025
claims: Open-Meteo archive returned grid point 39.47276 N / -0.3734436 E at 23 m elevation for Valencia.
Across the 11 race Sundays 2015-2025, daily maximum temperature ranged 14.0-23.6 C with a median of 16.5 C; daily minimum ranged 4.5-13.8 C with a median of 9.3 C.
Two of the 11 days recorded at least 1 mm precipitation (2016: 9.4 mm; 2022: 1.1 mm); total precipitation over the 11 days was 10.5 mm.
Daily maximum wind speed ranged 7.3-36.1 km/h with a median of 15.4 km/h.
These are modelled reanalysis values for a grid point, not course measurements, and are not a 2026 race-day forecast.

verification.checkedVia: Invoke-RestMethod 请求 archive-api.open-meteo.com，按 11 个赛事周日提取 daily 序列并计算中位数/区间
